# proxmox_node_disk_lvmthin (Resource)

Creates an LVM thin pool inside an existing volume group through `/nodes/{node}/disks/lvmthin` and waits for the worker task. Destroy removes the thin pool, its storage config and the data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_disk_lvmthin" "thin" {
  node   = "pve-1"
  name   = "thin1"
  device = "/dev/disk/by-id/ata-..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) Block device for the new volume group and thin pool. **Proxmox wipes it.**
- `name` (String) Thin pool name. Changes require replacement.
- `node` (String) Cluster node that owns the disk. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `add_storage` (Boolean) Create a Proxmox LVM-thin storage entry. The Proxmox default is `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `<node>/<name>` form.
